acceptance_criteria.criterion: Run Preflight calls API.orchestratorStart({ planPath, dryRun: true }) and renders a pass/fail checklist.
Start Run is enabled only when all preflight checks pass; calls API.orchestratorStart({ planPath }).
Queue table auto-polls every 5s and renders each entry with correct status badge, elapsed time, and progress.
Pending entries show a kill button; started entries link to project detail; dead entries show a dismiss button.
Expanding a row shows an inline log preview via OrchestratorWidgets.renderLogPreview().
CLI reference card is visible at the bottom of the view.
All log preview cleanup functions are invoked on re-render or navigation.

summary: Implemented full Orchestrator view in gui/public/views/orchestrator.js covering all 7 acceptance criteria.
Section A: plan path input + Run Preflight button (calls API.orchestratorStart(planPath, true)) + pass/fail checklist rendering with fix hints.
Section B: Start Run button gated on allChecksPassed flag; calls API.orchestratorStart(planPath, false) on click.
Queue table: auto-polls every 5s via Router._setPolling; renders status badge, elapsed time, and progress badge per entry.
Row actions: kill button for pending entries, project link for started entries, dismiss button for dead entries — all delegated to OrchestratorWidgets.
Expand/collapse toggle: clicking a row toggle starts OrchestratorWidgets.renderLogPreview() and registers the cleanup in _orchLogPreviewCleanups.
Cleanup: module-level _orchLogPreviewCleanups array is drained on every renderOrchestrator() call and on every refreshQueue() call.
CLI reference card rendered at the bottom via OrchestratorWidgets.renderCliReference().
All 25 view-specific tests pass; full GUI suite (597 tests / 21 files) passes with zero regressions.

comments.note: gui/public/views/orchestrator.js: _orchBasename() and _orchElapsed() are module-level private helpers but not namespaced. If the SPA grows and more view scripts are added to the same global context, name collisions become possible. Consider prefixing them with the module name (e.g. _orchViewBasename) or migrating them to the OrchestratorWidgets namespace in a future pass.

gui/public/views/orchestrator.js: The module-level _orchLogPreviewCleanups array is shared state at global scope. In the current SPA architecture this is fine (one view at a time), but it is an implicit contract that is easy to miss. A brief inline comment already documents it — no action needed now, but worth tracking if the architecture evolves.

gui/public/js/orchestrator-widgets.js: renderLogPreview() appends div.log-preview-entry elements with raw textContent (action string or JSON.stringify). For structured JSONL events a richer formatter would improve readability — this is deferred to a future UX pass.

comments.note: _orchLogPreviewCleanups draining is wrapped in try/catch per cleanup entry — a cleanup error will not block subsequent cleanups or break the render cycle. Good defensive pattern.
The allChecksPassed closure variable is properly reset to false on both API error and after a successful start — Start Run remains disabled until a fresh preflight confirms all checks pass again.
No blocking issues found. All 25 dedicated tests and 610 total GUI tests pass cleanly.

summary: PASS with Fix-Forward. All 7 ACs verified through prior pipeline artifacts and source review.
escapeHtml() applied consistently to all user-supplied data in HTML string building. No XSS vectors found.

Fix-Forward applied: renderPreflightResults() now resets startBtn.textContent to 'Start Run' when enabling the button. After a successful start the textContent remained 'Starting…'; subsequent successful preflight would re-enable the button with stale text. 616 GUI tests pass.

_orchLogPreviewCleanups draining is correctly placed in both renderOrchestrator() (full navigation re-render) and refreshQueue() (per-poll re-render). Cleanup errors are swallowed per-entry to prevent cascading failures.
OrchestratorWidgets IIFE namespace pattern is appropriate for the SPA architecture. renderCliReference() maintenance comment correctly references the live CLI surface.

comments.note: Fixed stale button text in renderPreflightResults(): after a successful start, startBtn.textContent was set to 'Starting…' and never reset. When the user subsequently runs preflight and all checks pass, renderPreflightResults() re-enables the button but previously left the text as 'Starting…'. Added `if (!startBtn.disabled) startBtn.textContent = 'Start Run';` immediately after the disabled assignment. Non-behavioral change; 616 GUI tests still pass.

_orchBasename, _orchStatusLabel, and _orchElapsed are module-level globals prefixed with _orch to reduce collision risk. In the current single-view-at-a-time SPA architecture this is acceptable. If the SPA grows and multiple view scripts are loaded simultaneously, consider migrating these to OrchestratorWidgets or a dedicated view-utils namespace.

renderLogPreview() appends raw textContent (action string or JSON.stringify). Adequate for current use. A richer JSONL-aware formatter (delegating to formatProgressEntry from orchestrator-manager.ts) would improve readability — deferred to a future UX pass.
